name: stageflow
description: Standardize Stageflow planning flows with durable request artifacts and validation gates.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Codex work and expose Simple Workflow plus atomic-docs.
interface.longDescription: Stageflow helps Codex inspect a project, clarify requirements, preserve request-specific artifacts, review plans, require explicit approval, proceed from a validated plan, and expose atomic-docs for small source-guided documentation of purpose, boundaries, contracts, implementation context, source locators, active changes, open questions, and direct dependencies. It also exposes Simple Workflow for a lightweight reviewed plan.md flow, atomic-impl for docs-first implementation from approved Atomic Docs RIDs, multi-repo-worktree for explicitly invoked permanent development worktrees with one-time create, squash-merge-safe generation branches, isolated PR corrections, source-to-prod branch promotion, and help, status, submit, promote, pull, and sync workflows, and uiux-workflow for explicitly invoked UI/UX implementation against project design.md guidance with a bounded subagent review cycle.
defaultPrompt: Use Stageflow to plan this change before coding.
Use Stageflow to clarify this request and create a validated plan.
Use Simple Workflow to capture requirements, write plan.md, review it internally, and wait for approval.
Use atomic-docs update all to create source-guided project documentation.
Use atomic-docs update changed to refresh affected Atom files.
Use atomic-docs inspect to check purpose, boundaries, contracts, implementation, changes, and open questions.
Use atomic-impl to record requirements as RIDs before implementing code.
Use $stageflow:multi-repo-worktree submit to publish ready PRs while preserving local follow-up work.
Use $stageflow:multi-repo-worktree promote to advance the configured source branches through dev, dev2, and prod.
Use $stageflow:uiux-workflow to implement and review a UI/UX change against the target project's design.md.
